description: Read-only search for candidate leftover local-ydb Docker volumes, dumps, and PDisk/data paths. It scans Docker volume names plus profile.storageSearchPaths and deletes nothing; use before local_ydb_cleanup_storage to decide exact paths or volumes to remove.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

name: local_ydb_storage_leftovers
